name: Dying ends the dungeon run (no Angel to take you back)

evidence.semantics: After a death the player wakes in the inn as usual, but the Angel never appears, ground items (the dropped gear and gold) are deleted and the dungeon's progress is cleared, as when forfeiting from the world map.
evidence.user_acceptance: accepted 2026-10-28: the user tested it in Patch_Manager and reported it works perfectly.
evidence.runtime: runtime_verified (Savestates/About_To_Die.ss0, visible input only, Patches/end_dungeon_on_death/test.py): English: Angel task starts in the inn (0x03003518 bit 21), Angel flies in outside, dropped hand armour 5/46 + gold on the ground list, progress table world+0x1C8 kept. English+mod and English+mod+lose_all_on_death (both orders, same SHA-256): no Angel task, no Angel outside, ground list holds only the town's own item (map 36), dungeon rows of world+0x1C8 cleared; wake-up, heal and walking unchanged. Second hook 0x08088F7C static only.

writes.note: Town arrival (inn wake-up after death): `bl 0x08065DF0` (start the Angel task, kind 1) becomes `bl 0x080bc1c0` (forfeit cleanup, no Angel).
Town arrival (town entry while bit 14 is set): `bl 0x08065DF0` (start the Angel task, kind 1) becomes `bl 0x080bc1c0` (forfeit cleanup, no Angel).

Allocation 0x080bc1c0..0x080bc1d3 (20 B, was zero; owner end_dungeon_on_death): forfeit() calls 0x0805DBC4 (delete all ground items), 0x08058634 and 0x08058768 (clear dungeon progress), as the world map does on departure.
